purpose: Freeze deterministic Treasury 10-Year auction demand-state semantics for Q104 M6 using validated Q019/Q024/Q025 PIT anchors.
fixed_source: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data 10-Year Note auction population
state_rule: Compare current bid_to_cover_ratio with immediately preceding same-tenor auction in chronological auction_date order; retain raw delta and sign state.
pit_rule: Event may enter a trading-day signal only at the validated release/record timestamp from the existing Treasury PIT chain.
